OPTISCAN.TITLE: Your documents, scanned in seconds
OPTISCAN.DESCRIPTION: OptiScan turns your phone camera into a professional scanner: it detects edges, corrects perspective, flattens folded pages, removes shadows and exports your documents as PDF or JPEG, ready to share.

FEATURES.FLATTEN_DESC: Straighten folded or curved pages and remove shadows from uneven lighting for a clean result.
FEATURES.FILTERS_DESC: Magic Color, B&W Contrast or Soft Gray. What you see in the preview is exactly what gets saved.
FEATURES.EXPORT_DESC: Choose the quality, share through your favorite apps, save to Files or your gallery, or print directly.
FEATURES.ORGANIZE_DESC: Search, categories, favorites and recents. Rename, reorder, add pages or edit them again whenever you want.

PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.INTRO: This privacy policy applies to the OptiScan app (hereby referred to as "Application") for mobile devices, created by Maximiliano Ariel Fava (hereby referred to as "Service Provider") as a free, ad-supported service with an optional subscription (OptiScan Pro). It explains what information the Application handles, how it is used and what choices you have.

COLLECTION.TITLE: Information the Application handles
COLLECTION.P1: OptiScan does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide your name, email address or phone number.
COLLECTION.P2: To work, the Application handles the following data:
COLLECTION.L1: Documents: the original photos you capture or import, the processed pages and the details you assign to them (name, category, favorites, page order). They are stored exclusively in the Application's private storage on your device.
COLLECTION.L2: Preferences: settings such as language, flash or export quality, and internal counters used to control how often ads are shown. These are also stored only on your device.
COLLECTION.L3: Subscription status: if you have an active OptiScan Pro subscription, information provided by Google Play to enable Pro features.
COLLECTION.P3: The Service Provider does not operate its own servers for the Application and does not receive, store or have access to your documents, images or extracted text. The Application does not collect your precise location or access your contacts.

PERMISSIONS.TITLE: Device permissions
PERMISSIONS.P1: The Application only requests the permissions needed for its features:
PERMISSIONS.L1: Camera: to capture the pages you scan. It is only used while the scanner screen is open.
PERMISSIONS.L2: Photos and storage: to import the images you choose from your gallery and to save your exports to the gallery or Files. On Android 9 or earlier, the storage permission is requested for this feature.
PERMISSIONS.L3: Internet: to show ads, verify your subscription with Google Play and download updates to the text recognition components.
PERMISSIONS.P2: You can revoke these permissions at any time from your device settings. Some features may stop working.

OCR.TITLE: Text recognition (OCR)
OCR.P1: The text extraction feature in OptiScan Pro uses Google ML Kit, which processes images directly on your device. Your documents and the recognized text are not sent to any server to perform recognition.
OCR.P2: According to its terms of use, Google ML Kit may occasionally contact Google servers to receive bug fixes and updated models, and send technical metrics about the feature's performance and usage, which do not include the content of your documents.

ADS.TITLE: Advertising
ADS.P1: The free version shows ads through Google AdMob. AdMob may collect and use your device's advertising ID, your IP address, technical device information (model, operating system, language) and your interactions with ads, in order to serve ads, measure their performance and prevent fraud.
ADS.P2: If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or another region where it is required, the Application will ask for your consent through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) before showing personalized ads. You can change your choice at any time from Settings › Legal › Ad privacy.
ADS.P3: You can also reset or delete your advertising ID from Android settings (Settings › Privacy › Ads, or Settings › Google › Ads, depending on your device). OptiScan Pro subscribers do not see ads.

PURCHASES.TITLE: Purchases and subscriptions
PURCHASES.P1: OptiScan Pro subscriptions are processed through Google Play Billing. Payment details (such as your card) are handled exclusively by Google; the Service Provider does not receive or store them. The Application only receives the purchase information needed to enable Pro features, such as the product purchased, its status and the purchase receipt.

THIRD_PARTY.TITLE: Third-party services
THIRD_PARTY.P1: The Application uses third-party services that have their own privacy policies about how they handle data:
THIRD_PARTY.P2: When you share or export a document, it is sent to the app or service you choose (for example, email, messaging or cloud storage), whose data handling is governed by its own policies.
THIRD_PARTY.P3: The Service Provider does not sell your personal information. Information may only be disclosed if required by law, for example to comply with a court order or similar legal process.

DATA_DELETION.TITLE: Data retention and deletion
DATA_DELETION.P1: Your documents remain on your device until you decide to delete them. You are in full control:
DATA_DELETION.L1: Delete a document or page: do it directly from the Application.
DATA_DELETION.L2: Delete all data: go to your device Settings › Apps › OptiScan › Storage and select "Clear data", or uninstall the Application.
DATA_DELETION.L3: Exported files: PDFs or images you saved to Files, to your gallery or shared with other apps are outside OptiScan and must be deleted there.
DATA_DELETION.L4: Advertising and purchase data: data handled by Google AdMob and Google Play is managed from your Google account settings or by resetting your advertising ID.
DATA_DELETION.P2: Since the Service Provider does not keep backups on external servers, deleted documents cannot be recovered. If you have questions about this process, you can reach us at the contact email below.

CHILDREN.TITLE: Children's privacy
CHILDREN.P1: The Application is not directed at children under 13, and the Service Provider does not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal information, please contact the Service Provider so the necessary actions can be taken.

SECURITY.TITLE: Security
SECURITY.P1: Your documents are stored in the Application's private storage, protected by Android's sandboxing, so other apps cannot access them. We recommend protecting your phone with a screen lock and not rooting it. No storage method is 100% secure, but the Service Provider strives to protect your information.

CHANGES.TITLE: Changes to this policy
CHANGES.P1: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The Service Provider will notify you of any changes by posting the new version on this page and updating the effective date. You are advised to review it periodically.

CONSENT.TITLE: Your consent
CONSENT.P1: By using the Application, you consent to the processing of your information as set out in this Privacy Policy.

CONTACT.P1: If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Application, please contact the Service Provider via email at
